Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Describes one way a custom scan can produce a table's rows, with the costs the planner compares against other
paths.

```csharp
public readonly struct PgCustomScanPath : IEquatable<PgCustomScanPath>
```

Costs use the same units as the table's existing paths, so a path cheaper than
[CheapestTotalCost](/api/ankus.pgcustomscanplanner/#member-10e930e9a3d14168) usually wins.

Implements: [IEquatable&lt;PgCustomScanPath&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iequatable-1)

Describes one way a custom scan can produce a table's rows, with the costs the planner compares against other
paths.

```csharp

```

Parameters:

`StartupCost` — [double](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.double)

The cost before the first row, in PostgreSQL's planner units.

`TotalCost` — [double](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.double)

The cost to produce every row, at least <code class="paramref">StartupCost</code>.

Costs use the same units as the table's existing paths, so a path cheaper than
[CheapestTotalCost](/api/ankus.pgcustomscanplanner/#member-10e930e9a3d14168) usually wins.

<a id="member-fb786ea8e9be9261"></a>

### Rows

Gets the estimated row count before the query's conditions, or null to keep the planner's estimate.

```csharp
public double? Rows { get; init; }
```

Value: [double?](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.double)

A path that depends on an outer query's values, such as inside a lateral join, always uses the planner's
estimate.
